definitions.gloss: ninety-nine percent; almost certainly; all but
definitions.explanation: Literally "nine parts and nine tenths of a part" out of ten, that is 99 percent. Used as an adverb or noun to say that something is all but certain or all but done, with a small chance left open.

examples.japanese: {九分九厘|くぶくりん}⟦{間違|まちが}いない→間違いない：17813_machigainai⟧。
⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{九分九厘|くぶくりん}{終|お}わった。
examples.english: The construction is all but finished.

examples.japanese: {九分九厘|くぶくりん}⟦{勝|か}てる→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っていた→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was all but sure we would win, but they came from behind at the end.

notes:
Built on the old decimal units {分|ぶ} (a tenth) and {厘|りん} (a hundredth): {九分|くぶ} = 90%, {九厘|くりん} = 9%. Note the readings: くぶ, not きゅうふん.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {九分九厘|くぶくりん}⟦{間違|まちが}いない→間違いない：17813_machigainai⟧: it is almost certainly so
- {九分九厘|くぶくりん}⟦{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}→大丈夫：00772_daijoubu⟧だ: it is all but certain to be fine
- {九分九厘|くぶくりん}⟦{完成|かんせい}している→完成する：25528_kanseisuru⟧: it is all but complete
- {九分九厘|くぶくりん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: almost all the way (to completion)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{十中八九|じっちゅうはっく}→十中八九：31105_jicchuuhakku⟧: in all likelihood (about 80–90%); a little less sure than {九分九厘|くぶくりん}
- ⟦ほぼ→ほぼ：00109_hobo⟧: almost, nearly; plain everyday word with no sense of a remaining chance
